statics.x_rest__mutmut_10.why: Rest searched from 1.0 rad instead of 0. The rest equation has exactly one root for any kappa > 0 (the passive pull only grows with stretch, so the residual strictly decreases), and from either start the walk ends in the same scan bracket, so the bisection is the same. Probed 26 Nov (mutant applied to a copy): the demo table (seed 1, 48 cases x 1500 builds) and 63,472 wide solves (soft hinges, equal stacks, starts on scan points, the hand-built joint): identical everywhere. (Reclassified from gap on review.)
statics.x_rest__mutmut_10.by: Claude, proposed 26 Nov and checked by probes: confirm
